title: Vijayanagara Empire
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🏛️ The Vijayanagara Empire (1336 - 1646)
blocks.intro: The supreme Hindu kingdom of Southern India, acting as a bulwark against northern Sultanate expansions.

blocks.heading: 1. History & Dynasties
bullets: Founded in 1336 by brothers **Harihara I & Bukka I** (Sangama Dynasty) on the southern bank of Tungabhadra River, inspired by sage Vidyaranya.
Four dynasties: Sangama, Saluva, Tuluva, and Aravidu.

**Battle of Talikota (1565):** Also known as Battle of Bannihatti. Combined forces of Deccan Sultanates (except Berar) defeated Vijayanagara army. Rama Raya was captured and executed. Capital Hampi was sacked.
**Foreign Travellers:** Nicolo de Conti (Italy, 1420), Abdur Razzaq (Persia, 1443), Domingo Paes (Portugal, 1520), Fernao Nuniz (Portugal, 1535).

formulas: Founded: 1336 (Harihara & Bukka) | Peak: Krishnadevaraya | Capital ruins: Hampi | Talikota: 1565
